observations: Photo 0: front of a black tower-style UPS with a blue vertical strip, a round power button and three indicator LEDs (mains, battery, fault icons).
Photo 0: 'BLUE GATE' moulded at the top of the front panel; the same name is faintly visible in photo 1.
Photo 1: the same unit from above and the side, a fairly deep desktop tower casing with side vents, a black mains cord ending in a round 3-pin plug resting on top.
No LED is lit in photo 0, so the photos do not show it powered on.
No rating label, VA or kVA figure, or model number is visible in either photo; the back panel and outlets are not shown.
Casing is dusty with light scuffs; no cracks or burn marks visible.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a Blue Gate UPS unit.

risks.risk: Capacity unknown; the VA or kVA rating that sets the price is not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up of the rating label on the back or underside showing model and VA rating.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the smallest Blue Gate unit that fits this casing.

risks.risk: Battery dead or weak, the usual failure in used UPS units; it may not hold any backup.
risks.proof: Clip of the UPS powering a lamp or PC, then unplugging it from the wall and showing it keep running for a minute.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing a new battery.

risks.risk: Electronics faulty; it may not switch on at all.
risks.proof: Clip of pressing the power button with the LEDs lighting and the beeper sounding.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, for parts.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged output sockets or cables at the back.
risks.proof: Photo of the back panel showing the outlets and ports.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating label showing the model and VA or kVA rating.
Clip of the UPS running a load, then unplugged from mains and still running.
Photo of the back panel with outlets.
Photo with a handwritten note bearing today's date and a code next to the unit.
response.reason: The brand Blue Gate is readable on the front and the item is clearly a desktop UPS; with the rating unseen and no power shown, it is priced at its worst case as the smallest unit of this casing, not working or with a dead battery.
